Average
May 2024 • Family
Not terribly impressed with the quality of the tacos. A tad bit on the exspensive side for 3 tacos, at 220k vnd for 3. However, he does not make his own taco shells , but buys them from Saigon Taco. So his cost is higher and the shells are not fresh. The only addition to the beef taco is cheddar cheese, chopped lettuce and diced tomatoes…..no pico de gallo. But the place has potential if they learn about Mexican cuisine. The eating area was clean and air conditioned. Soft drinks are reasonably priced at 25k vnd. The staff spoke great English and were very friendly.

Taco Tim did well
Mar 2024 • Couples
We really enjoyed one Super Tim chicken Burrito. It was packed full of shredded chicken, and it was not too spicy. We were even able to pour some extra chilli sauce onto it. Then we shared the 3 taco deal. They allowed us to split it with 1 beef and 2 chicken. Both tacos had great flavour and were very crisp. Not a cheap meal compared to local Vietnamese food, but it didn’t break the budget. We recommend this small restaurant, and we would return if in the area again. The man serving spoke excellent English. Try to get one of the two small tables outside for people watching.
